annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国国务院令第832号 国务院关于修改《社会团体登记管理条例》的决定
annotation.title_en: State Council Decree No. 832: Decision of the State Council on Amending the Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Social Organizations
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.venue: 中华人民共和国国务院公报 / gov.cn
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council Decree No. 832 (12 March 2026) amends the Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Social Organizations, adding rules for merging or terminating industry associations, liquidation, and revocation of registration certificates. It includes the full republished regulation. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Authorities may require merger or termination of industry associations and chambers of commerce that are too small, overlapping or ineffective.
Liquidation procedures are strengthened, including court-appointed liquidation groups.
Registration revocation is expanded to cover failure of internal management and failure to complete deregistration.
The full amended regulation is republished.
